verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that OneDrive can share files and create sharing links via Graph, and that external sharing is supported. Nothing in the pack documents folder- or file-level permission roles (viewer/commenter/editor/owner) or how permissions are inherited. Generic sharing links and external-sharing settings are adjacent features, not the granular role model with documented inheritance that this story asks for.

support.subject: As an IT admin, permissions are granular — folder- and file-level roles (viewer/commenter/editor/owner) with inheritance behavior documented
